IIB_spin_topology.crucial_distinction: Even g>2 has two spin structures, but that does not imply a globally descending Killing spinor; deck transformation phases and local Killing equations are separate.
IIB_spin_topology.flat_U1_local_systems: Hom(pi1(Y),U(1)) has exactly g characters, distinct from number of spin structures.
IIB_spin_topology.linking: Tor H²(Y) paired perfectly with Tor H⁴(Y) with generator unit +/-1/g (mod 1).
IIB_spin_topology.spin_structures: Spin structures form a torsor over H^1(Y;Z2)=Hom(Z_g,Z2), so 1 structure for odd g and 2 for even g.
IIB_spin_topology.topological_fact: TY is stably isomorphic to pi* T(S2xS2) plus trivial vertical line, so w2(TY)=0; every nontrivial Y(p,q) is spin.

KK_modular_chambers.BF_violating_iff: 0<lambda<12 for the proven equal-flux odd KK branch

analytic_exact_two_mode_strip.proof: n != 0 implies lambda>=3*pi*y>12; |m|>=2,n=0 implies lambda>=12*pi/y>12; m=+-1,n=0 has lambda=3*pi/y<12.

KK_modular_chambers.false_conclusion_to_avoid: Four BF modes is a square-torus statement, NOT a uniform lower bound over all torus shapes. An open modular strip has only two real unstable harmonics in this branch.
KK_modular_chambers.spectrum_scope: Classical equal-flux branch only; other sectors and flux-asymmetric physical mixing not counted.

X8_second_variation.IMPORTANT: Algebraic deltaR not required to be realizable Levi-Civita perturbation. Does not compute the physical second functional variation, full action, flux terms, or corrected BF masses.
X8_second_variation.X8_polynomial_convention: P(R)=tr(R^4)-(1/4)*(tr R^2)^2; overall physical normalization omitted
X8_second_variation.t_squared_coefficient_exact_formula: 2 tr(R deltaR R deltaR) - [tr(R deltaR)] wedge [tr(R deltaR)]

e6_filter_symmetry.group_theory: By Schur's lemma, a discrete internal transformation commuting with irreducible E6 on a single 27 is proportional to identity. Residual discrete hypercharge also cannot forbid a subset of E6-invariant cubic monomials, because each already has total Y charge zero.
e6_filter_symmetry.important_caveat: The mixing counterexample requires an additional unfiltered up-type heavy state. Mixing among strictly zero-source states alone cannot generate the operator.
e6_filter_symmetry.perturbative_Wilsonian_theorem: A fixed N=1 supersymmetric holomorphic Wilsonian superpotential is perturbatively nonrenormalized; this does not predict the tuned coefficients, forbid additional UV operators, remove heavy gauge-boson channels or protect against vacuum shifts and SUSY-breaking effects.

photon_active_router.scope: The permutation is an abstract unitary routing schedule, NOT a tested fast optical switch or a realistic time-bin quantum memory. Active device losses and switching times require calibration.
photon_active_router.theorem: For a passive stationary shift-covariant network U*T=T*U, outputs from successive input time bins are time-translated copies, not different spatial rails at the same time. Exact coherent demultiplexing requires active time-dependence or equivalent nonstationary storage/control.
